spellbook.finance/limitations: The request must use both the current preparationId and case version. A stale address or case fails without resolving it.
For tracked dispatch, the tracking number is recorded as seller-supplied evidence. SpellBook does not verify carrier acceptance or send it to a marketplace.
A new explicit dispatch is distinguishable from legacy tracking-completion evidence, which remains available only for compatibility.
Workspace owner role is backend-enforced. This writes only to the workspace you name.

description: Explicitly record that the seller mailed a returned order using its current preparation. Choose tracked with the tracking number or stamped/untracked with no tracking number, and send mailingConfirmed true only after mailing. The case resolves and leaves active work; its original order shipment remains unchanged. SpellBook does not verify carrier acceptance, buy postage, contact the buyer, or update a marketplace.

caseId.description: Exact return caseId from returned-order work. Required.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

expectedVersion.description: The current case version from returned-order work. Required to reject a stale dispatch.

idempotencyKey.description: A caller-generated key retained across retries.

mailingConfirmed.description: Explicitly confirm the package was mailed. Printing alone is not enough.

method.description: Use tracked only with a supplied tracking number. Use untracked for stamped mail with no tracking number.

preparationId.description: The current preparationId from returned-order work. A stale preparation is rejected.

trackingNumber.description: Tracking printed on the replacement mailer. Required exactly when method is tracked.

workspaceId.description: The seller workspace from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_returned_package_reship_dispatch
